title: Bizagi Pricing - Consumption-Based Pricing For Full Flexibility | Bizagi
markdown:
# Bizagi Pricing

#### Bizagi's PaaS offers consumption-based pricing for full flexibility.

[View pricing brochure](https://go.bizagi.com/Brochure-BizagiPricing_LP1Registration.html) [Request a quote](https://www.bizagi.com/en/contact-us)

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Icons/scale-48x.svg)

##### Start Small and Scale

Our consumption-based pricing enables you to start small at a lower initial investment, and then scale based on your needs over time. This makes transformation programs more accessible and reduces risk.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Icons/roi-48x.svg)

##### Shared Success

Pricing based on usage creates a better correlation between cost and the value delivered. Bizagi is fully driven to help you deliver platform adoption and maximum business value.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Icons/collaborate-48x.svg)

##### Unlimited Users & Apps

With no limits on the number of users or apps within your subscription and the ability to include suppliers and partners, you're free to experiment, creating new apps and automations without incurring any immediate cost.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Resources/quote-texture.svg?t=thumbnail3)

#### Bizagi provides an inexpensive starting point for commitment, while addressing diverse use cases and scale. The model is flexible and drives market disruption."

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Customers/forrester_logo.svg)
